aggregate_sha256_definition: SHA-256 over sorted '<sha256>  <path>\n' lines for every entry whose kind is not `store` or `fuzz`.
description: Deterministic enumeration of every conformance vector. Paths are relative to the program home. `content_root` is the BLAKE3 domain-separated identity recorded by the vector (for WCB, H("weft/structured/v1", canonical bytes)); `decoded_sha256` is SHA-256 over the exact decoded byte string the vector records. Null means the format does not define that value for the kind.
